messages.author: Malinok
messages.text: How do less then 2k soldiers defeat 12k.  I could only send 1 soldier per support.  I lost a lot of shit that I can't replace by someone that failed on their first two attacks.  Then procced to kick my ass and drop my moral from 100 to 0 while I slept.  I'm ready to say fook this game until they fix this.  The war guide gives jack shit on combat details.

messages.author: Malinok
messages.text: If this was changed just so I could sleep and wake up Fooked, you may want to consider how you are implementing changes.

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text:
<@176063647880052737> went through war 557 battle by battle (all times UTC):
- Oct 10 17:19, 18:33, 21:48 and Oct 11 03:29: you won all four fights as defender
- Oct 11 08:31: we removed the old war supply limit. attacks now cost action points only, and defenders field their whole army (that limit is what made "1 soldier per support" a thing before)
- 09:00:21, 09:00:50, 09:01:16, 09:01:42: Lerslen won four ground fights in about 80 seconds, each a decisive win. your morale dropped 15 per fight (100 -> 40)
- 09:32 and 09:33: two air strikes took 20 morale each. you had no fighters to answer them, so morale hit 0 and the war ended

the maths: a soldier fight is decided by army size. your ~12k soldiers score about 83, and a decisive win needs about 3x that, so roughly 37k+ soldiers. Lerslen has about 46k, so it was around 4 to 1, not 2k vs 12k. the fights only look small because the losses logged were tiny (you lost about 140 soldiers in total and still have 11,861).

sorry it landed mid-war. what helps next time: dig in (+10% defence per level), keep some fighters so air strikes cost you less, and keep soldier numbers up. if the 2k number came from something you saw on screen, send a screenshot and i will look at it.

messages.author: Dede
messages.text: and most importantly <#1448838653173563533> is where you can vent out all your ideas for a better war system, which I desperately am thinking how to do too

messages.author: Malinok
messages.text:
In the future a buffer for the change would be nice.  I didn't know the strengths.  I only know I had 2 defensive wins and two offensive wins, really don't know how given the numbers.  To waking up to utter defeat.  
I would suggest that wars should need 24 hours for a victory., if the one side is continuously victorious.   This is coming from someone that is usually the raider in these games.
